Mission Statement
Central Prairie Human Service Zone provides services to individuals and families who are vulnerable to meet basic needs and to promote self-sufficiency.
Values
All people are treated with dignity and respect.
High quality service is the goals of all programs.
Promote a strong partnership with individual clients.
Promote leadership on community wide needs.
The agency will strive to be responsible and efficient stewards of all resources
Overview
Central Prairie Human Service Zone is a department of Foster County government that has been designated by law to provide poor relief and related services to the citizens of Foster County. The majority of the services/programs offered by the county are done in conjunction with state and federal agencies, particularly the North Dakota Department of Human Services. Central Prairie Human Service Zone provides a wide range of services including both social services and economic assistance programs. Some services are provided directly by county employees and others are provided through contracts.
Administrative Structure
Central Prairie Human Service Zone is directly responsible to the Central Prarie Human Service Zone Board. The Board is directly accountable to the Wells County Commission and, where designated, the North Dakota Department of Human Services. The Board consists of seven members who are appointed by the Foster, Eddy, and Wells County Commissioners. The Human Service Zone Board meets monthly. The Board appoints the Director of Social Services.
Personnel
Personnel include a county director, social worker, two eligibility workers, and one homemaker.
Civil Rights Statement
Foster County makes available all services/assistance without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, handicap or political affiliation and is subject to Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and the Age Discrimination Act of 1975 as amended and the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1991.
Programs
Please contact the agency for description of these services
Central Prairie Human Service Zone provides
Child protection services
Family foster care services
Parent aide services
Family preservation services
Daycare licensing and self-declaration services
Children's Special Health Services
Adult home and community based services
Adult family foster care
Information and Referral services
Economic assistance services
General assistance and permanency funds
